Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_shows_open_alert.py (5/5 pass) — POST /api/shows with email=fake-test@example.invalid returns a 6-char code; first GET /api/shows/{code} returns 200 with payload (Resend fail to .invalid handled gracefully — no 5xx bubble), /stats reports opens=1 and non-null last_opened_at; second GET → opens=2, still 200; /stats also exposes expires_at + protected=false; share without email path is unaffected. Prior test_shows.py (5/5), test_shows_stats.py (4/4), test_shows_pin_extend.py, test_shows_expiry_email.py all still green. Frontend Playwright (offline key Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T, legal accepted, dialog handler + IndexedDB seed of tiny mono 16-bit PCM WAV blobs for takes A/B/C/D): (1) Folder-scoped Drag-Sort — seeded vault A(Promos), B(Promos), C(Unfiled), D(Promos); Promos filter shows only A,B,D and hides C; dragging D above A via real DragEvent+DataTransfer with 150 ms gaps (dragstart→dragenter/dragover→drop→dragend) reorders the Promos view to [D,A,B]; switching to 'All' preserves C at global index 2 → [D,A,C,B]; localStorage 'hotlive95_state'.vault matches; full page reload keeps the [D,A,C,B] order. (2) Vault Waveform — 3s after opening the vault with decodable WAV blobs, vault-wave-B and vault-wave-D render mini bar rows; no crash/console errors from lazy decode. (3) Template Categories — cleared 'hotlive95_note_templates', typed a Promo note, selected 'Promo' in cloud-note-template-tag select, clicked cloud-note-save-template → chip shows leading '[Promo]' label; saved a second 'Overnight' template → cloud-note-tag-filters row + cloud-note-tag-filter-Promo/-Overnight chips appear; clicking Promo filter hides the Overnight template; clicking the Promo chip inserts its text into cloud-send-note; localStorage now stores objects with {text,tag}. Injected a legacy plain string 'TEST_Legacy_String' and reloaded — it still renders alongside tagged templates (backward-compat normalization confirmed). (4) Open Alerts — the observable side (opens counter + 200 status on .invalid recipient) is fully covered by the new pytest module; not asserting live Resend delivery per instructions. No new blocking console errors — only the pre-existing benign 'visual-editor <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning from PlayerBar dev-tooling.

Currently OK because takes always arrive with their blob, but worth documenting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: HTML5 drag-sort in TakesVault MUST use a real DragEvent with a real DataTransfer instance and 150 ms waits between dragstart → dragover → drop (setDragId is async React state). Playwright's dispatch_event('dragstart', {dataTransfer:{}}) fails because dataTransfer isn't converted — instead run page.evaluate() and use `new DragEvent(type, {dataTransfer: new DataTransfer(), bubbles:true, cancelable:true})`. To exercise the vault waveform, seed IndexedDB store 'hotlive95/audio' with a valid mono 16-bit PCM WAV Blob keyed by take.id; peaks then appear ~3 s after the vault opens. Templates now persist as {text,tag} objects — loadNoteTemplates normalizes legacy strings, so injecting a plain string into 'hotlive95_note_templates' is a good back-compat check.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs. Only tooling note: Playwright ElementHandle.dispatch_event cannot serialize a bare {} into a DataTransfer, so the first attempt at the folder-scoped drag failed with 'Failed to convert value to DataTransfer'. Switching to page.evaluate + real DragEvent + real DataTransfer inside the page context fixed it and matched the async-setDragId timing requirement from iteration 22.
